summary.title: Lost at SQL - SQL learning game
summary.one_liner: A browser-based, text-driven game by Robin Lord that teaches basic SQL querying for data scientists and marketers, with a learning mode and an expert challenge mode.
keywords: how to get information out of databases
sql vs using gpt to write queries
takeaways: SQL is a standard, transferable skill for pulling information out of databases, and it is useful for large datasets such as GA4 and Search Console exports in BigQuery.
Most SQL work is exploring data, debugging unexpected results, and cleaning data, not just writing queries.
Lost at SQL offers a learning game that starts from basics and an expert challenge mode for experienced users.
The game requires JavaScript; the site is built with Angular and the author recommends enabling it before playing.
summary.summary: This is the landing page for Lost at SQL, a SQL learning game by Robin Lord aimed at helping people pick up basic SQL so they can query data. The page argues for SQL's value in business analysis, citing BigQuery, GA4 exports, Search Console data and site speed datasets, and contends that understanding and investigating data matters more than writing queries by hand. It then explains how to start: enable JavaScript, pick a character, choose Learning game or Expert challenges, and play through a tutorial. The page does not list specific lesson topics or pricing.
